title: acetosella acetosella
intro: Acetosella acetosella, commonly known as Cranberry, is a deciduous shrub native to northern Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include supporting urinary tract health and reducing the risk of kidney stones due to its high concentration of proanthocyanidins. The therapeutic actions of Cranberry are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe gastrointestinal issues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Cranberry include anthocyanins, proanthocyanidins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
